_comment: Shared source of truth for reserved hotkey shortcuts. Consumed by BOTH the frontend (voice_typer/client/src/renderer/src/components/hotkey-validation.ts via Vite JSON import) AND the backend (voice_typer/server/config_validators.py via json.load). HOTKEY-SHARED-001 (Task 1.4): the previous architecture duplicated this table in two places (RESERVED_SHORTCUTS in hotkey-validation.ts and _RESERVED_HOTKEYS in config_validators.py) with no automated sync mechanism. A mismatch between the two silently accepted/rejected conflicting hotkeys. This JSON file is the single canonical source — both layers load it at module init. A CI test (tests/test_hotkey_reserved_sync.py) verifies the two in-memory structures are byte-identical.

_format.universal_reserved: Array of hotkey strings blocked on EVERY platform (window management: Alt+Tab, Alt+F4, Alt+Esc, Alt+Space). Stored lowercase with angle brackets, e.g. "<alt>+<tab>".
_format.per_platform_reserved: Object mapping platform key (win32/darwin/linux) to array of hotkey strings blocked on that platform only.
_format.blocked_ctrl_letters: Array of single lowercase letters blocked when the hotkey is PURE Ctrl+<letter> (no other modifier). Covers Copy/Paste/Undo/Save/Select All/etc.
_format.modifiers: Array of modifier key names recognized in hotkey strings (pynput-style, lowercase).
